name: cf-agent-memory
description: Personal agent memory on Cloudflare's free tier — MCP server with hybrid recall over D1 + Vectorize.

DB.description: D1 database holding memory rows and the FTS5 index. Created automatically on first deploy.

VECTORIZE.description: Vector index for semantic recall. Created automatically with 1024 dimensions and cosine metric.

AI.description: Workers AI, used for `@cf/baai/bge-m3` embeddings. No key required.

USER_MEMORY.description: Durable Object that keeps a per-user rate-limit counter.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Bearer token clients must send. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
